description: This file defines the entity class LoanTransactionToRepaymentScheduleMapping, which maps a loan transaction to a repayment schedule installment, including various portion amounts like principal, interest, fees, and penalties. It includes methods for creating, updating, and retrieving these components, with integration to the underlying database via JPA annotations.

classes.name: LoanTransactionToRepaymentScheduleMapping
classes.description: Entity representing the mapping between a loan transaction and a repayment schedule installment, including amounts for different portions and methods to manipulate these.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Factory method to create a new mapping instance from a loan transaction, installment, and monetary amounts.

methods.name: getLoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment
methods.description: Returns the associated repayment schedule installment.

methods.name: updateComponents
methods.description: Updates the component amounts using Money objects.

methods.name: setComponents
methods.description: Sets the component amounts directly with BigDecimal values.

methods.name: isZeroAmount
methods.description: Checks if the total amount is zero or null.
